name: UT Work queues
description: Unit tests of every Work queue command on queues named ut_...: add, take, finish, fail, defer, tag, copy, move and delete items, the Queue has items condition and the Each work item loop. The queues are queue files in the workspace; every queue is emptied at the end.

variables.name: ut_dir
variables.description: Folder with the test data (files, workbooks, fixtures).

variables.name: standin_url
variables.description: Address of the local stand-in that imitates outside services.

variables.name: ut_report
variables.description: One line per case: PASS or FAIL, the command and the case.

args.title: 0. About this agent

args.text: Unit tests of every Work queue command on queues named ut_...: add, take, finish, fail, defer, tag, copy, move and delete items, the Queue has items condition and the Each work item loop. The queues are queue files in the workspace; every queue is emptied at the end.
